_doc: Advisories the shared Security workflow (scripts/npm-audit.mjs in ValentinTorassa/.github) reports as warnings instead of failing. Each entry needs id, package, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and reason. Remove an entry once a release without the advisory is in the lockfile; the script flags entries that no longer match anything.

allow.reason: ReDoS with single-branch repeated extglobs. Published 2026-11-17 with no fixed picomatch release yet (every version is affected). Here picomatch is only a dev/build dependency (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir, micromatch) matching globs from our own config, never user input. Remove once a fixed release is in the lockfile.
